title: A Counterexample to the Gaussian Completely Monotone Conjecture
summary: We provide an explicit probability measure on $\mathbb{R}$ for which the fifth time derivative of the entropy along the heat flow is positive at some time. This disproves the Gaussian completely monotone (GCM) conjecture (Cheng-Geng '15) and therefore also the Gaussian optimality conjecture (McKean '66) and the entropy power conjecture (Toscani '15). Our proof also implies the existence of a log-concave probability measure on $\mathbb{R}$ for which the GCM conjecture fails at some order. The explicit counterexample was found by GPT-5.5 Pro.
